# Suggested GitHub topics

Maintainers can set these under the repository's **About → settings → Topics**:

```text
mcp ai-agents payments stablecoins usdc base x402
```

The `x402` integration supports the official v2 exact Base Sepolia protocol with a credential-free mock-settlement demo. Keep repository descriptions and launch posts clear about the testnet/simulation boundaries. Suggestions here do not automatically change GitHub metadata.
